description: This file defines API endpoints, request/response schemas, and related components for managing DHCPv4 Server Pool Conditional Rules within the Services.Local.DHCP.Server.v4.Pools namespace. It includes method definitions for adding, listing, retrieving, setting, and deleting DHCPv4 pool rules, with detailed response schemas and parameters.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new DHCPv4 Server Pool Conditional Rule with specified configuration.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves a list of DHCPv4 Server Pool Conditional Rules with optional pagination.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific DHCPv4 Server Pool Conditional Rule by RuleId.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Modifies an existing DHCPv4 Server Pool Conditional Rule identified by RuleId.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified DHCPv4 Server Pool Conditional Rule.
